name: aktar
title: Aktar
description: Upload files to your own S3, R2, B2 or MinIO storage, search your upload history, and browse your buckets with the Aktar menu bar app.
author: merttopuz

commands.name: upload-clipboard
commands.title: Upload Clipboard
commands.subtitle: Aktar
commands.description: Upload the file or image on your clipboard and copy its link.

commands.name: upload-finder-selection
commands.title: Upload Selected Files
commands.subtitle: Aktar
commands.description: Upload the files selected in Finder to your default destination and copy their links.

commands.name: upload-file
commands.title: Upload File
commands.subtitle: Aktar
commands.description: Pick files, a destination, and an optional name, folder, or auto-delete time, then upload them and copy their links.

commands.name: search-uploads
commands.title: Search Uploads
commands.subtitle: Aktar
commands.description: Search your upload history, copy links in any format, show QR codes, and delete uploads.

commands.name: browse-buckets
commands.title: Browse Buckets
commands.subtitle: Aktar
commands.description: Browse the folders and files in your destinations' buckets: copy links, create temporary links and QR codes, rename, move, delete, and upload.

commands.name: connect
commands.title: Connect to Aktar
commands.subtitle: Aktar
commands.description: Pair this extension with the Aktar app. Aktar asks you to approve the connection once.

preferences.name: copyFormat
preferences.title: Copy Format
preferences.description: What the primary copy action and uploads put on your clipboard.

preferences.name: deleteAfter
preferences.title: Delete After
preferences.description: Default for Upload Clipboard, Upload Selected Files, and the Upload File form. Aktar deletes the uploaded file from your bucket after this many days. Needs Aktar 0.5.0 or later.

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: Only needed if you don't use Connect to Aktar. Copy it from Aktar > Settings > Integrations.

preferences.name: port
preferences.title: Port
preferences.description: Only used together with the API Token above. Must match the port in Aktar > Settings > Integrations.

tools.name: list-destinations
tools.title: List Destinations
tools.description: List the storage destinations (buckets) configured in Aktar, and which one is the default.

tools.name: search-uploads
tools.title: Search Uploads
tools.description: Search the files uploaded with Aktar by name, newest first, with their public links.

tools.name: list-bucket-files
tools.title: List Bucket Files
tools.description: List the folders and files in one folder of a destination's bucket, including files not uploaded with Aktar.

tools.name: create-share-link
tools.title: Create Share Link
tools.description: Create a temporary, presigned link to a file in a bucket that works even when the bucket is private.

ai.instructions: Aktar uploads files to the user's own S3-compatible storage. A destination is one configured bucket; when the user doesn't name one, use the default destination. Public links come from search-uploads or list-bucket-files; only use create-share-link when the user asks for a temporary or private link, or when a file has no public link.

If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
